name: Morgan
goal: Morgan wants to find a book that will spark interesting and respectful conversations among the club members, without being too challenging or off-putting for anyone.
backstory: Morgan has been leading the book club for three years and prefers novels with relatable characters, having particularly enjoyed their discussion of Celeste Ng's Little Fires Everywhere last year. She worries that a poorly chosen book might lead to low attendance or unengaging discussions. Morgan tends to spend several hours researching potential books before making a decision.

beliefs.concession: if the group agrees on a classic with modern themes

name: Drew
goal: Drew wants to find a book that will stimulate a thoughtful and engaging discussion without overwhelming any of the participants.
backstory: Drew has been looking forward to the book club all week and prefers novels with well-developed characters, having particularly enjoyed the last selection that explored complex family relationships. They worry that if the group chooses a very long or dense book, some members might struggle to finish it on time. Drew usually prepares for discussions by jotting down notes as they read.

beliefs.concession: if the group agrees on a manageable reading schedule

name: Riley
goal: Riley wants to find a book that will spark an engaging discussion without being too divisive or overwhelming for the group.
backstory: Riley recently finished a mystery novel and is looking for something different, but still enjoys a page-turner, having previously led a successful book club discussion on a thriller that everyone loved, though they worry about suggesting something too obscure, and tend to overthink their recommendations.

beliefs.concession: if most members have read it before
